---

## What it does

You ask the agent to do something that takes hours — pull down a 40 GB model, wait for a
compile, sit through an installer. The agent starts the job, the turn ends, and it goes to
sleep. The job is still running. **Nothing tells the agent when it finishes**, so nothing
tells you either: you have to wander back and ask.

This plugin makes DSH watch the condition for you. When it is met, the plugin injects one
message into the session and wakes the agent — so the agent reports to you by itself.

```
you:      fetch that 20 GB thing and tell me when it's done
agent:    (starts the download → turn ends → asleep)
            ...hours later...
plugin:   *sees the file size stop changing* → *injects a message* → *wakes the agent*
agent:    "Done — 20.3 GB, and I verified the checksum against the published one."
```

## Why it exists

An agent is a request/response process. Once a turn is over it has no clock, no timer and no
way to learn that a `curl` it launched has exited or that a file has appeared on disk. Under
DSH the only thing that can hand it that fact is a message arriving in its inbox — which is
exactly what a session looks like when *you* type something. If nothing sends one, the agent
stays asleep until a human pokes it.

So the missing piece is not the waiting, it is the *waking*. This plugin is the thing that
wakes it.

## Mechanics

The wake-up uses the same call DSH itself uses when a subagent reports back to its parent
agent (see `dsh-subagent/lib/continuation.js`):

```js
agent.steer(createUserMessage({
    content: [{ type: 'text', text: message }],
    source: { kind: 'plugin', plugin: 'dsh-proactive' },
}))
```

`agent.steer(...)` is the door into a session that is not currently running a turn;
`createUserMessage(...)` builds the message object that door expects. This is DSH's own API
surface, not a private back channel.

`source.kind = 'plugin'` is the default, and it matters: a plugin-originated message **is not
rendered in the UI**. You do not see a fake bubble pretending to be something you typed —
you only see the agent's reply, which is the whole point. `source.kind = 'user'` is available
per-entry if you deliberately want the message rendered as a user bubble, and it is used by
the test suite to prove the difference is real.

## Trigger types

| `type` | Fires when | Required fields |
|---|---|---|
| `file-stable` | The file size is unchanged across `rounds` consecutive checks — **the standard "download finished" test** | `path`, `rounds` (default `stableRounds`, 3) |
| `file-exists` | The path exists **as a file** (a directory does not count) | `path` |
| `file-size` | The file exists and its size is ≥ `bytes` | `path`, `bytes` (default 0) |
| `process-exit` | The named process is gone — **the job it was doing is over** | `process` (e.g. `curl.exe`) |
| `port-open` | A TCP connection to `host:port` succeeds — **the service came up** | `port`, `host` (default `127.0.0.1`) |
| `time` | The clock passes `at` — an alarm | `at` (ISO date-time; bare = local, `Z` = UTC) |

Unknown types never fire; they are skipped silently rather than guessed at.

### Common fields

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Identifies the entry in `boot.log` and in the default message. Any string. |
| `message` | What the agent reads when it wakes. Write it as an instruction to the agent, not as a note to yourself. |
| `sessionId` | Optional. Wake only this session. If it is not open, the entry is skipped for that tick and stays armed — it is **never** redirected to another session. Omit to wake the most recently active one. |
| `sourceKind` | Optional. `plugin` (default, not rendered) or `user` (rendered as a user bubble). |
| `form` | Optional, with `sourceKind: 'plugin'`. Free-form tag on the source; `notice` also carries a `summary` (first 120 chars of `message`). |
| `repeatSeconds` | Optional. Re-arm instead of firing once — see below. |

### Which session gets woken

When several DSH sessions are open, exactly one is chosen:

1. **`sessionId` set** → only that session. If it does not exist the entry is skipped, logged,
   and left armed. Refusing to fire is deliberate: a reminder delivered to the wrong session
   is worse than no reminder.
2. **`sessionId` absent** → the **most recently active** session. Activity means a message
   arrived in its inbox, its status turned `running`, or the session started. Not "the last
   one registered" — that older rule woke the wrong session when two were open, and it is
   pinned by five tests (`C. session selection`).

### One-shot versus repeating

A fired entry is stamped `fired: true` and never fires again. With `repeatSeconds` the entry
is **re-armed** instead, and `firedCount` / `lastFiredAt` record the history:

- `time` → `at` moves to now + `repeatSeconds`.
- `file-size` → `bytes` is raised to the current file size + 1, so the next byte appended
  fires it again.
- Any other type → `repeatSeconds` is meaningless and the entry silently degrades to one-shot.

Entries whose files are actually a moving target (a growing log, a progress file) are what
`repeatSeconds` is for.

## Install

The plugin imports `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`, so it has to sit somewhere Node can resolve that
package from — a normal place for that is inside the profile's module tree.

```bash
# 1. put the plugin next to (or inside) your DSH profile
git clone https://github.com/mili1360/dsh-proactive.git ./dsh-proactive

# 2. register it in <profile>/package.json
#    dependencies:        "dsh-proactive": "link:<absolute path to the plugin>"
#    dsh.profile.bundles: [ "dsh-proactive" ]      <- add to the array
```

Then verify the import resolves from the plugin directory:

```bash
node -e "import('@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm').then(m => console.log('createUserMessage =', typeof m.createUserMessage))"
# createUserMessage = function
```

If that fails, link the package the way DSH exposes it — for example a `node_modules/@deepseek-ai`
junction inside the plugin directory pointing at `<profile>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai`.

**Restart DSH.** `dsh.marketplace.requiresRestart` is `true`, and a newly registered bundle is
not picked up without one. Afterwards the plugin directory contains `boot.log`, and three
lines mean it loaded:

```
apply() 被调用  enabled=true  intervalMs=15000
定时器已挂载
守夜人就绪
```

No `boot.log` means the bundle never loaded — check the profile registration again.

## Requirements / compatibility

**After installing, confirm it actually works — a profile that boots is not proof.**
A plugin can load cleanly, serve its routes and still break the host; we have seen exactly
that. So the acceptance test is: **create a new session and send it one message** (the plugin
is idle until a watch fires, so a quiet log is expected), then confirm the session exists and
the agent answered. If new sessions cannot be created at all, remove the mount line above and
restart.

Developed and tested against DSH **`0.1.0-rc.7`** — a **customised** build, not a stock
upstream release. Another version may register its services or name its events differently:
this plugin uses `ctx.on`, `ctx.effect`, `ctx.agents`, the `agent/created`,
`agent/session-start`, `agent/inbox/inserted`, `agent/status` and `agent/disposed` events, and
`agent.steer` + `createUserMessage` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`.

If your build does not match, the plugin **deactivates and says so** — it does **not** stop the
profile from booting. Nothing keeps running (no listeners, no timer), and `boot.log` gets ONE
line instead of the ready line:

```
注册失败，插件停用: ctx.on 不可用（这个 DSH build 没有它）
```

**If the profile will not start at all after installing**, remove the mounted lines from

# ZY-Agents ZY-Agents 是单租户自托管的企业级多智能体平台，采用**管理面与执行面分离**的架构：主服务负责认证、编排与数据，内核宿主负责 Agent 运行时与本地工具执行。 ## 架构概览 ``` ┌───────────────┐ ┌────────────────┐ │ apps/web │ │ apps/admin │ │ Vue3 用户端 │ │ Vue3 管理端 │ └──────┬────────┘ └───────┬────────┘ │ HTTP (REST) │ └─────────┬──────────┘ ▼ ┌─────────────────────┐ │ services/api │ │ FastAPI 业务面 │ │ 认证 / 编排 / 知识库 │ │ 技能 / 配额 / 审计 │ └─────┬─────────┬─────┘ │ │ model gateway tool gateway ← 双网关（HMAC 签名回调） │ │ ▼ ▼ ┌─────────────────────────┐ │ services/kernel-host │ │ Node.js DSH 执行面 │ │ Runtime Profile 内容寻址│ │ 回合循环 / 工具桥 / 审验 │ │ 审批 / 事件日志 │ └───────────┬─────────────┘ │ 本地 Agent 配对 ▼ ┌────────────────┐ │ 本地 Agent │ │ CLI + Chromium │ └────────────────┘ ``` ## 核心特性 - **回合制 Agent 编排** — 管理面下发任务，执行面按回合循环驱动模型与工具，状态可恢复 - **知识库检索** — 全文检索起步，可扩展嵌入与重排 - **技能注入** — 技能以 Runtime Profile 内容寻址方式进入 Agent 上下文 - **审批 broker** — 敏感工具调用经人工审批后执行 - **事件日志全链路** — 每个回合、每次工具调用均可追溯 - **白标 / 品牌化** — 展示层品牌（名称 / logo / 主题色）按部署配置，与契约层隔离 - **本地 Agent 配对** — CLI + 独立 Chromium 的本地执行，适配内网无 API 的存量系统 ## 快速开始 ### 前置依赖 - Python >= 3.11（主服务） - Node.js >= 22（内核宿主与前端构建） - MongoDB 与 Redis（本地开发可用 `make mongo-up` / `make redis-up` 拉起，或使用系统安装的实例） ### 启动步骤 ```bash # 1. 生成 .env 密钥（JWT、双网关签名、签名 URL 等） make bootstrap # 2. 编辑 .env，配置 OpenAI 兼容模型服务： # MODEL_PROVIDER_BASE_URL=... # MODEL_PROVIDER_API_KEY=... # MODEL_PROVIDER_MODEL=... # 3. 初始化数据库（索引 + 种子账号 + 服务端工具目录，幂等可重复执行） make mongo-up make redis-up make init-db # 4. 一键启动全部服务（api / kernel / web + mongo / redis） make dev ``` > 说明：数据库初始化也可以跳过（API 首次启动时会自动完成同样的初始化，全部幂等）；`make init-db` 的价值是**启动前显式完成并可查看初始化结果**（打印种子账号写入数、集合文档数）。本地运行数据（Mongo 数据文件、`data/`、`.localdata/`）不进仓库，git 跟踪列表只含源码与文档。 启动后访问 **http://127.0.0.1:4173**（用户端）。各服务端口：主服务 API `127.0.0.1:8000`、内核宿主 `127.0.0.1:8101`、用户端 `127.0.0.1:4173`。 停止服务：`make down`；查看日志：`make logs`。 ### 种子账号 首次启动且用户集合为空时，自动创建三个演示账号（用户名固定，**密码由环境变量注入、不落代码**）： | 用户名 | 角色 | 密码变量 | |---|---|---| | `admin` | 管理员 | `SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD` | | `ops` | 运维（受限管理） | `SEED_OPS_PASSWORD` | | `member` | 普通成员 | `SEED_MEMBER_PASSWORD` | 首次部署前在 `.env` 中配置这三个密码；生产部署务必修改或删除这些账号。 ### 配置说明 - 全部环境变量模板见 [.env.example](.env.example)，每个变量均带注释说明用途与默认值。 - JWT、双网关签名等密钥由 `deploy/bootstrap/generate-secrets.sh` 自动生成（`make bootstrap` 调用），请勿手工编造、勿入库。 ## 项目结构 ``` ZY-Agents/ ├── services/api/ # FastAPI 主服务（业务面：认证、编排、知识库、技能、双网关） ├── services/kernel-host/ # Node.js 22 DSH 内核宿主（执行面：回合循环、工具桥、审批、事件日志） ├── apps/web/ # Vue3 用户端 ├── apps/admin/ # Vue3 管理端 ├── deploy/ # 部署脚本与密钥生成 ├── docs/ # 设计文档（六份） └── Makefile # 本地开发入口（bootstrap / dev / check 等） ``` ## 文档索引 | 文档 | 内容 | |---|---| | [00-architecture-spec.md](docs/00-architecture-spec.md) | 架构规格：约束与结论、部署形态、服务分层、双网关、升级机制 | | [01-engineering-design.md](docs/01-engineering-design.md) | 工程设计：目录树、分层依赖规则、模块接口、装配与编排 | | [02-data-model-and-api.md](docs/02-data-model-and-api.md) | 数据模型与 API：MongoDB 集合字段、公开 HTTP 路由表 | | [03-kernel-contract.md](docs/03-kernel-contract.md) | 内核契约：双网关端点与签名方案、宿主协议、版本锁 | | [04-localagent-protocol.md](docs/04-localagent-protocol.md) | 本地 Agent 协议：配对流程、帧级字段、连接状态机 | | [05-spec-compliance.md](docs/05-spec-compliance.md) | 合规登记：约束落点与检测手段 | ## 社区讨论 欢迎扫码加入微信群「dsh 企业应用开发技术」，一起交流企业级 Agent 平台架构、DSH 内核与本地工具执行的落地实践：

## License [MIT](LICENSE) © ZY-Agents Contributors

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-intelligent-ui

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-intelligent-ui)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-intelligent-ui)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-intelligent-ui)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-intelligent-ui)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4d6bfe)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-442%20passing-brightgreen)](#development)

**Generative UI for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): the model writes an interface instead of describing one.**

An open-source take on what ChatGPT calls **Intelligent UI** (internal codename *DIL*) and Claude calls **Artifacts** — the model's answer stops being prose about a dashboard and becomes the dashboard. Sliders you can drag, toggles you can flip, numbers that recompute locally with no second model call, and a card the model can revise in place while keeping your place.

Everything is one tool (`artifact`), two rendering paths, and an on-disk artifact layer.

> Keywords: DSH plugin · DeepSeek Harness plugin · generative UI · GenUI · ChatGPT Intelligent UI · Claude Artifacts · declarative DSL · worker sandbox · native DOM render tree · artifact version history

## What it is

Ask for something you would otherwise only read about — *"a plan calculator where I can change seats and billing period"* — and the reply **is** a working calculator. The model writes a small declarative document, DSH compiles and runs it in a sandbox, and the host draws the result with native DOM: real controls, the host's own type scale, the host's own colours, correct in both light and dark mode.

Three things follow from that, and they are the whole point:

- **You operate the answer.** A chart whose inputs you change, a checklist you tick, a config you tune — not a screenshot of one.
- **It stays correct.** Ask for a change and the model patches the same artifact in place. Version history means the revision you were looking at is still on disk.
- **It survives the session.** Artifacts are persisted, so a card from last week is still patched in place today, after an app restart.

## The two paths

| | Compiled path — `engine: "dil"` (default) | Escape hatch — `engine: "html"` |
|---|---|---|
| The model writes | a DIL document: prose, `{@body …}` declarations, one root `<box>` | a self-contained document: `css`, then `html` |
| Who executes it | a **DOM-less Worker** inside the frame runs the compiled program | the frame runs the document itself |
| Who draws it | **the host**, from a render tree, using native DOM | the frame draws itself |
| What you get | theme for free, few tokens on the wire, controls wired to each other, structure streams out first | no ceiling (canvas, WebGL, D3, your own simulation) |

The distinction that matters: **the sandbox is an execution container, not a display container.** Compiled code runs in a Worker that has no DOM, and emits a render tree the host draws. "Code inside the card reaching the host's elements" is therefore not blocked — there is no path for it to happen.

## Install

From npm:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-intelligent-ui
```

Or straight from the repository:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:yunyv/dsh-intelligent-ui
```

Then **restart the app**. The build output is committed, so a git install needs no build step and no build permission.

From a tarball, if you prefer to pin an exact artifact:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-intelligent-ui-0.1.0.tgz
```

From a checkout, for development:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/yunyv/dsh-intelligent-ui && cd dsh-intelligent-ui
pnpm install && pnpm run check
bash scripts/reinstall-desktop.sh
```

Do not install this by linking the source directory. A link exposes `node_modules/@deepseek-ai/*` — which exists only for type checking — to the Loader; Node resolves to those copies, their own transitive peers are not installed, and the import throws `Cannot find package`, which takes the whole plugin down.

## Use

Nothing to configure. Ask for something interactive and the model reaches for the tool. A DIL document looks like this — prose, declared state, then one tree:

```
{@body const [seats,setSeats] = DIL.useState(5)}
{@body const [yearly,setYearly] = DIL.useState(false)}
{@body const total = 200 * (yearly ? 10 : 12) * seats}
<box gap={4}>
  <title size="lg">Team subscription cost</title>
  <slider label="Seats" value={seats} onChange={setSeats} min={1} max={50}/>
  <checkbox checked={yearly} onChange={setYearly}>Billed yearly</checkbox>
  <card>
    <caption>Per year</caption>
    <title size="xl" tabularNums>${total.toLocaleString()}</title>
  </card>
</box>
```

(The `$` is a literal currency sign and `{total.toLocaleString()}` is the interpolation — DIL is not JavaScript template syntax, it only borrows the braces.)

The authoring contract — the full component inventory, the rules that make a document run — ships as a bundled **skill**, so it loads only when a turn is actually about to write one rather than sitting in every request. Say `skill genui` to read it.

Where the card appears is under the model's control too: it writes a fenced block whose language is `dsh-artifact` and whose only content is the artifact id, and the frame is mounted at that point in the answer.

## How it works

```
src/tool.ts            every decision the tool makes; imports no @deepseek-ai/*, so tests drive it directly
src/index.ts           the harness binding: Config, store root, registration, presentation hooks
src/dil/               the ported streaming DIL compiler (parser, codegen, streaming boundaries, fallback)
src/store/             the on-disk artifact layer
src/client/            the browser half: fence claiming, engine dispatch, sidebar panel
src/client/dil/        sandbox, render-tree renderer, patch model, state loop
assets/genui-skill.md  the DIL authoring contract, loaded as a bundled skill
vendor/dil-replica/    the upstream replica, verbatim (see PROVENANCE.md)
```

The compiler is a streaming compiler. It is fed a growing prefix of the document and reports which components have closed and which are still open, so the card can appear while the model is still typing it. Recovery is not all-or-nothing: a half-written element is dropped and everything around it still renders.

An artifact can be on screen twice — live in its card and again in the right column — and the two share one state, so a control moved in either one moves both.

## The artifact store

Persisted under `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-intelligent-ui/`, with the data model borrowed from [coda0HQ/open-artifacts](https://github.com/coda0HQ/open-artifacts) (MIT):

```text
index.json                               the catalogue; never holds content
artifacts/art-xxxxxxxx/versions/
  v0001.html  v0001.json                 content and metadata kept apart
  v0002.html  v0002.json
```

Versions are **appended, never rewritten**. Each carries `versionNumber`, `parentVersionId`, `contentSha256`, `contentBytes` and a `changelog`; `restore` appends a new head rather than editing history; `expectedLatestVersion` gives optimistic concurrency; `read(id, N)` fetches any historical revision.

The write order is content → sidecar → atomic index replace, and both the read and the write path treat the disk as the source of truth, so a crash in the middle cannot leave the head pointing at bytes that are not there.

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `storeRoot` | `''` | artifact directory; empty means `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-intelligent-ui` |
| `maxSourceBytes` | `2000000` | refuse a document larger than this |
| `maxArtifactsPerSession` | `40` | per-session artifact ceiling |
| `includeDegradedText` | `true` | append the plain-text projection the model can read back |

## Development

```sh
pnpm run check     # typecheck (3 projects) && build && vitest && the vendored upstream suite
```

442 tests pass: 344 ours, 98 vendored from upstream. The browser half is tested against the **built** `lib/client.j

plugins.readme_text: # @snnh/dsh-llm-service-lite English | [中文](README.zh.md) > **Community plugin.** Maintained by [snnh](https://github.com/snnh). It is not > an official DeepSeek package: DeepSeek neither publishes nor supports it, and > issues belong in this repository. ## Install A harness loads plugins from a profile's own installation, so this package is installed into a profile rather than into the harness itself: ```sh # From the published package: dsh plugin --profile web add @snnh/dsh-llm-service-lite # Or straight from this repository. pnpm builds the checkout while installing, # which the profile must allow first: run the command, add the exact key pnpm # printed under `allowBuilds` in /pnpm-workspace.yaml, and re-run it. dsh plugin --profile web add github:snnh/dsh-llm-service-lite ``` ### Mount The package declares itself a bundle (`dsh.bundle.patch`), so the install above also mounts its `llm-service-lite` row: one command installs and mounts, and no hand-written entry is needed. The mount is dormant — no route exists until a profile declares one. Configure it through the Models page, which writes profiles into the `llm-service-lite:` settings section the plugin reads live, or through an entry in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` carrying the `providers` dictionary described under [Configure provider profiles](#configure-provider-profiles). The profile patch is applied after every bundle layer, so that entry's `config` replaces the row's empty default; the same entry also mounts the plugin in a composition that declares no bundle layer, because it names the module to load: ```yaml - id: llm-service-lite name: '@snnh/dsh-llm-service-lite' config: providers: # ... provider profiles, one per endpoint ``` Mount it exactly once. When a composition already carries an `llm-service-lite` row — the `dsh-base` bundle of [dsh-lite](https://github.com/snnh/dsh-lite) ships one — that row already reaches this package, so the profile adds no bundle layer of its own; install the package without activating it as a bundle (for example `dsh plugin --profile web add -D @snnh/dsh-llm-service-lite`) and configure the existing row. Two rows with the same id mount two instances that claim one settings namespace, which fails plugin loading. ### Compatibility This package drives the public seam of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` and the `@deepseek-ai/cordis` service layer, so it runs against a published harness rather than a checkout: its peers are the harness packages, and the profile that loads it already owns the copies the runtime uses. Two declarations of the [dsh-lite](https://github.com/snnh/dsh-lite) harness are used when the running harness carries them and skipped when it does not: the model-defaults registration seam a configuration surface asks for declared model ids, and the `outputModalities` field on a model's info. An upstream harness has neither, and this adapter then keeps its family defaults to the request path, where they still fill the fields a profile left open. ## Summary `@snnh/dsh-llm-service-lite` adapts third-party model endpoints: one route per configured provider profile, all answered over its transports — the OpenAI-compatible chat-completions wire, the Anthropic Messages protocol, and the OpenAI Responses API — so no provider SDK and no installed catalog sits in the request path. A profile is self-contained — wire protocol, endpoint, credential reference, request-body extras, concurrency, image input, and the models served — so a gateway, a national API, and a corporate proxy reach one code path. The shape ports OpenWebCode's model-provider layer onto the harness seam: one document describes every provider, and the route set follows it live. ## Table of Contents - [Install](#install) - [Use this package](#use-this-package) - [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation) - [Further Exploration](#further-exploration) - [Model Experience](#model-experience) - [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) ----- ## Use this package Mount this plugin when a deployment wants to describe its model providers itself instead of naming providers an installed catalog already knows. The `providers` dictionary is the whole configuration surface: each key is the provider route a request selects with `GenerateOptions.provider`, and the value is everything that endpoint needs. ### When to choose it This plugin adapts third-party endpoints and nothing else: every route it registers comes from a profile a deployment wrote, and the first-party DeepSeek channel keeps its own adapter. DeepSeek is that channel by default, so the route names it owns — `deepseek-official` and `deepseek-account`, registered by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek-api-key` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek-account` — are refused here by name, with the owner in the diagnostic, rather than claimed and left to fail plugin loading. DeepSeek itself keeps those modules — this adapter is not a substitute for that channel. Any other route name is free: a deployment that reaches a DeepSeek-compatible endpoint through this adapter names its own route and declares that endpoint's own capabilities. Choose this adapter when the same composition serves several endpoints — a national model API, a self-hosted vLLM or SGLang gateway, and a proxy on the corporate network — and each must be described completely rather than derived from a catalog. Choose `dsh-llm-pi-ai` when a pi-ai catalog entry already supplies the protocols and model capabilities. Both adapters can be mounted together because their route names do not collide; registering a route another adapter already owns fails plugin loading. ### Configure provider profiles ```yaml - id: llm-service-lite name: '@snnh/dsh-llm-service-lite' config: providers: # A provider reached at its published API, with the key from the seam. deepseek: displayName: DeepSeek interfaceType: openai-chat-completions baseURL: https://api.deepseek.com/v1 apiKeyEnv: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY includeUsage: true models: - id: deepseek-chat contextWindow: 131072 maxTokens: 8192 - id: deepseek-reasoner contextWindow: 131072 maxTokens: 65536 capabilities: effort: [low, medium, high] thinking: [enabled, disabled] reasoningContent: true # A self-hosted gateway: body fields only this server understands. vllm: interfaceType: openai-chat-completions baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1 extraBody: top_k: 40 maxConcurrent: 1 models: - id: Qwen3-32B contextWindow: 32768 maxTokens: 8192 capabilities: effort: [low, high] thinkingStyle: enable_thinking # An endpoint reached over the Responses API, with encrypted reasoning # replay declared. openai: interfaceType: openai-responses baseURL: https://api.openai.com/v1 apiKeyEnv: OPENAI_API_KEY models: - id: gpt-5 contextWindow: 400000 maxTokens: 128000 capabilities: effort: [minimal, low, medium, high] thinking: [disabled] responsesEncryptedReplay: true # An endpoint reached over the Anthropic Messages protocol, with prompt # caching and its thinking modes declared. claude: interfaceType: anthropic-messages baseURL: https://api.anthropic.com/v1 apiKeyEnv: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY promptCaching: true models: - id: claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 contextWindow: 200000 maxTokens: 64000 capabilities: thinking: [enabled, disabled] # This endpoint reads a later system message as the effective # prompt and activates tools inside the conversation. systemPromptUpdate: in-history toolUpdate: in-history #

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的生图桥插件：让没有生图/修图能力的模型接上外部生图模型。可添加多个服务商，为生图与修图各选主用与备用模型，备用接入时自动接管，全部在 Web 界面点击配置。
plugins.readme_text: # 生图桥 dsh-image-bridge [English](README.en.md) | 中文 [![stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/kkj-luna/dsh-image-bridge?style=flat)](https://github.com/kkj-luna/dsh-image-bridge) [![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4f8cff)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 里**没有作图能力的模型**接上外部生图服务。装一个插件，模型就多出 `image_generate`（生图）与 `image_edit`（改图）两个工具，图片作为持久附件出现在对话里，同时另存到会话工作区 `generated-images/`。 ![生图桥](docs/promo-banner-zh.png) 设置页： ![生图桥设置页](docs/settings-zh.png) ## 安装 装插件（包在 npm 上，一条命令）： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add kkj-luna-dsh-image-bridge ``` 重启 `dsh web`，打开 **设置 → 生图桥**。装的是预构建产物，不用克隆仓库、不用记本地路径，也不会触发源码构建授权。 前提是本机装着 `@deepseek-ai/dsh`（`dsh web` 跑得起来）。没有就先装： ```sh npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh ``` **懒得敲命令？** 让 Agent 装：新建对话，把下面这句发过去，它会自己装、重启并核对结果。 ```text 帮我安装这个插件：dsh plugin --profile web add kkj-luna-dsh-image-bridge 装完重启 dsh web，并确认「设置 → 生图桥」能打开、两个工具已注册。 ``` **想跟最新提交**（npm 上还没发到那一版时）： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:kkj-luna/dsh-image-bridge ``` **改代码时**用本地目录装（会写成 `link:` 依赖，改完重启即可）： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add <本仓库绝对路径> ``` > **刚发布的版本可能装不到。** pnpm 默认有 **24 小时发布年龄门槛**（`minimumReleaseAge`，防止刚被投毒的版本立刻被装上）：新版本发布后 24 小时内，上面那条命令会**静默退回上一个版本**——你看到装成功了，但装的不是最新的。 > > 想立刻装到指定版本，点名版本号即可绕过门槛： > > ```sh > dsh plugin --profile web add kkj-luna-dsh-image-bridge@0.4.2 > ``` > > 检查实际装到的是哪一版：看设置页页头徽标的版本号，或 `dsh plugin --profile web list`。 ### 装完怎么确认 重启 `dsh web` 后，三条任选（**重启是必须的**，插件代码不会被热重载）： - 打开 **设置 → 生图桥**，能看到设置页； - `$DSH_HOME/dsh-image-bridge-startup.json` 里 `steps` 有三步（`Config schema 就绪` / `两个工具已注册` / `测试通道已挂载`）、`services.tools` 为 `true`； - 会话里模型能调用 `image_generate` 与 `image_edit` 两个工具。 ### 卸载 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove kkj-luna-dsh-image-bridge ``` 也可以在「设置 → 插件」里删。 | 你可能想知道 | 答案 | | --- | --- | | 包名为什么带 `kkj-luna-` | 为了在 npm 上唯一——`dsh-image-bridge` 已被别人占用。设置页徽标只显示仓库名 `dsh-image-bridge` | | 为什么不直接发 npm | 已经发了。`github:` 那条只是给"想跟最新提交"的人用的备选 | | 装完要不要重启 | **要**，插件代码不会被热重载 | | 从旧版本升上来配置会丢吗 | 不会。行 id 与设置命名空间一直是 `image-bridge-v4`，包名换过两次但它只是个安装标识 | | 想改代码怎么办 | 见[完整手册](docs/manual.md)的「开发本插件」——那是开发者路径，普通使用不需要 | ## 三步开始 1. **添加服务商**：设置 → 生图桥 →「＋ 添加模型提供商」，填接口地址（如 `https://api.openai.com/v1`）与 API Key。 2. **先测试、再保存**：点「测试连接」，模型列表出来后点浮层的**「保存」**。 3. **选模型并画图**：回到页面的「模型」区块，为生图、改图各选一个模型（可各配一个备用），点「保存模型设置」；然后直接对模型说「帮我画一只戴宇航头盔的柴犬」。 > **最容易踩的一步**：下拉候选来自**已经保存**的模型列表。只测试不保存就关掉浮层，模型不会进下拉——顺序是「测试连接 / 获取可用模型」→「保存」→ 下拉里才有。 ## 你会得到 - **画图不靠模型本身**——当前模型有没有作图能力都不影响：它调用插件，插件去问外部生图服务，图片回传成对话里的图片附件 - **多家服务商并排**——每家各自的接口地址与 API Key，卡片上直接看连通状态；点一次「测试连接」顺带把这家的可用模型列出来 - **模型随便搭**——生图和改图可以选不同厂商的模型，各配一个主用 + 备用；主用失败自动换备用，并告诉你换成了哪个 - **只列能画图的模型**——你的 Key 可能带几百个模型，默认只显示判定为生图的那几个，想看全部点一下开关 - **尺寸可选**——八种常用预设，也可以自己填任意尺寸串 - **密钥不外泄**——API Key 存进 DSH 凭据服务（`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`，权限 `0600`），不写进配置文件，也不回传浏览器 - **升级不丢配置**——服务商、模型、尺寸存在 profile 里，更新插件不影响 ## 支持的服务商 任何 **OpenAI 兼容**接口都行：OpenAI、智谱、通义千问、SiliconFlow，以及各类中转服务。生图打 `POST {接口地址}/images/generations`；改图打 `POST {接口地址}/images/edits`（multipart 上传参考图，参考图用会话工作区里的路径）。只要两样：接口地址与 API Key。 ## 超时与换备用 生图接口是同步的，憋几十秒很正常（实测 42–61 秒）——所以**只在连不上时换备用，不因为画得慢换人**： | 行为 | 值 | | --- | --- | | 连接超时（设置项，按秒填） | 默认 **15** 秒 | | 备用的连接上限 | 固定 **30** 秒，不是设置项 | | 整次调用上限 | `timeoutMs`，默认 **180000** 毫秒 | - **连接超时只管「请求有没有发出去」**：DNS / TCP / TLS / 代理在 15 秒内没把请求发出去，就算这家连不上，改用备用模型。 - **请求一旦发出就不再计时**：服务商画多久都照等，由 `timeoutMs` 兜底。所以地址填错最多等 15 秒就换人，正常的慢生成不会被误判。 - **三种情况换备用**：连不上（连接超时或网络层直接失败）、非 2xx（含回包不是合法 JSON）、回包正常却解析不出任何可用图片。 - **两种不换**：你在界面上主动取消；图片已经产出、只是下载失败——已经计过费，不该再生成一次。 - **两家都连不上时**，错误以「**模型连接失败**」开头，并列出两次尝试各自的原因；想确认某家到底通不通，点设置页的「测试连接」。 > 老版本按「响应快慢」换备用，配置里那项叫 `fallbackAfterMs`（「主模型超时(毫秒)」，默认 90000）。**这项已整体删除**，老配置里的值会被当作未知字段丢掉，不影响运行。 ## 常见问题 先看设置页的**状态灯**和卡片上的失败原因，多数问题那里就写着答案。 | 现象 | 原因 | | --- | --- | | 「没有可用的 API Key」 | 这张卡片没填、也没存过密钥。**不是**网络错误——请求根本没发出去 | | 「密钥被拒绝（401/403）」 | 请求发出去了，服务商不认这把 Key | | 「获取可用模型」报 404 | 这家不提供 `/models`，不影响生图 | | 四个下拉是空的（禁用） | 还没保存过模型列表：测试连接 → **保存**。四处提示里说的「手动输入…」是**下拉里的一个条目**，而空状态下下拉本身是禁用的——先按上面两步把列表存上，才能选到它 | | 设置里没有「生图桥」这一页 | 查插件是否启用、客户端日志里 `client apply` 是否 fatal；**改过代码要重启 DSH**（热重载默认忽略 `node_modules`） | ## 安全与隐私 - **密钥不落配置**：API Key 存 `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`（`0600`），配置文件里只有凭据名；密钥不回传浏览器，也不进日志。 - **没有显式密钥就不发请求**：请求里既没有显式密钥、也没有合法的凭据引用时，Host **一个字节都不发**，绝不拿别家服务商的密钥顶上；地址同样不回退。 - **对方给的图片地址要过 SSRF 关卡**：服务商可以回一个 URL 让客户端去下载——那个地址是**它给的**，所以只允许 `http`/`https`，并拒绝 `localhost` / `.local` / 环回与私网网段（`127.x`、`10.x`、`172.16-31.x`、`192.168.x`、`169.254.169.254`、`fe80:` / `fc` / `fd` 等）。 - **你自己填的接口地址允许本机**：本地生图服务是正当用法，只要协议是 http/https。 - **回包与下载都有上限**：回包正文 32 MiB，下载图片 15 秒 / 20 MiB，读取可被取消。 - **删除服务商不清理密钥**：删除只是配置操作。想清掉就自己删 `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` 里的那一行。 ## 开发与验收 ```sh node .dib-verify/verify-manifest.mjs # 47 清单与跨文件一致性 node .dib-verify/verify-client.mjs # 183 客户端注册与组件渲染 node .dib-verify/verify-host.mjs # 147 Host 端到端 node .dib-verify/verify-security.mjs # 34 安全边界（SSRF 逐跳拒收、回包上限、条目封顶） node .dib-verify/verify-resolve.mjs # 8 依赖解析健壮性 node .dib-verify/verify-upgrade.mjs # 24 升级后用户配置是否保留 ``` 共 **443 条断言**，无需联网、无需真实密钥。跨进程端到端另需先起一个本地模拟接口： ```sh node .dib-verify/mock-image-api.mjs 8799 # 另开一个终端 node .dib-verify/verify-cross.mjs ``` 脚本路径全部现场推导，没有写死机器路径；缺环境时会报错并告诉你要设哪个变量（`DSH_BIN` / `DSH_PROFILE_DIR` / `DIB_PLUGIN_DIR`）。 **为什么有 `verify-upgrade`**：用户的服务商配置**不在插件里**，而在 profile 的那一行上。插件自身的测试永远发现不了「改名 / 改行 id / 改默认值把用户已保存的配置弄丢」。这一套直接调用 Harness 真实导出的 patch 合成算法，按真实层序合成后断言配置零漂移。 ## 目录 **仓库根目录就是插件包本身**（v0.3.0 起，这是一键安装的前提）： ``` package.json cordis.patch.yml 插件清单与挂载声明 index.js client.js Host 半与客户端半 locale/ icon.svg 插件卡片文案与图标 README.md docs/manual.md 本文件（仓库门面 / npm 页）与完整手册 .dib-verify/ 测试与验收套件（随仓库走，不进包） generated-images/ 生图输出（已忽略，不入库） ``` `.npmignore` 把 `.dib-verify/`、截图与本地缓存挡在包外——插件装到用户机器上时只有跑起来需要的东西。 ## 已知限制 - **改了插件代码要重启 DSH**：Node 缓存已加载模块，热重载忽略 `node_modules`（配置热更新是另一条通道，不受影响） - **导航栏图标是权宜方案**：外壳按 section id 硬编码图标，第三方插件一律是齿轮。本插件挂载后「认领自己那一行」换成自己的标记；等官方 `settings.section` 支持 `icon` 后应改回官方能力 ## 文档 | 文档 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | [插件完整手册](docs/manual.md) | 配置项、行为细节、排查、实现要点 | | [变更记录](CHANGELOG.md) | 每个版本改了什么（当前 **v0.4.3**） | | [验证报告](.dib-verify/verify-report.md) · [第二轮](.dib-verify/verify-report-2.md) | 独立验证结论（含未覆盖范围） | | [上架插件市场](docs/marketplace.md) | 想让它出现在插件市场里？条目文件与 PR 步骤 | ## 反馈 提 [issue](https://github.com/kkj-luna/dsh-image-bridge/issues) 时附上三份自诊断文件的路径，排查会快很多： | 文件 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | `$DSH_HOME/dsh-image-bridge-startup.json` | Host 每次激活覆写，含当前实际在用哪个服务商 | | `$DSH_HOME/dsh-image-bridge-client.log` | 浏览器侧日志，**不含密钥** | | `$DSH_HOME/dsh-image-bridge-degraded.json` | 只在依赖解析失败时出现 | ## 许可 [MIT](LICENSE)

# dsh-restart-hotkey

> **DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 桌面端快捷键重启插件**  
> 一键自定义快捷键极速重启 DSH 桌面端，支持防误触二次确认弹窗、动态按键录制、通用设置面板集成与进程安全拉起机制。

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-DSH%20Desktop%20%7C%20Windows-green.svg)](#)

---

## ✨ 功能特性

1. **安全稳定的应用无缝平滑重启**：
   - 彻底关闭原有 Electron 主进程及所有常驻子进程，并在释放系统句柄与端口锁定后通过 Windows Shell 独立拉起全新的 `DeepSeek Harness.exe`，避免父子进程生命周期锁定问题。
2. **应用内专属生效**：
   - 仅在 DSH 窗口处于激活前台焦点状态时捕获按键，绝不与系统其他全局热键或常用软件冲突。
3. **支持完全自定义快捷键（默认 `Ctrl+Shift+R`）**：
   - 支持在设置页面中自由录制，支持鼠标点击后**直接敲击键盘组合键自动录制**，无需手动输入繁琐的键名。
   - 提供常用预设一键切换（`Ctrl+Shift+R`、`Alt+R`、`F9`、`Ctrl+Alt+R`）。
4. **防误触二次确认弹窗**：
   - 按下快捷键时弹出优雅的确认对话框，提供“确认重启 (Enter)”与“取消 (Esc)”。
   - 支持直接勾选“下次直接重启，无需确认”，亦可在弹窗底部直接点击“更改快捷键”完成按键重绑。
5. **多处无缝设置入口**：
   - **【设置】→【通用】页面**：在 DSH 默认的通用偏好列表中直接嵌入配置行，开箱即可调配。
   - **【设置】左侧导航独立页面**：提供专属的独立卡片设置界面。
   - **【插件】→【配置】**：与 DSH 插件管理生态全面对齐。

---

## 🛠️ 安装方法

### 方式一：目录链接安装（推荐开发调试）
1. 将本项目 clone 或解压到本地目录（如 `C:\Users\<YourUser>\Documents\DSH\dsh-plugin\dsh-restart-hotkey`）。
2. 打开 **DSH 桌面端 → 左侧栏「插件」→「安装插件」**。
3. 填入插件项目目录的绝对路径，点击安装。
4. 安装完成后重启 DSH 即可生效。

### 方式二：打包安装 (npm pack)
在项目根目录下打包：
```bash
npm pack
```
在 **DSH 桌面端 →「插件」→「安装」** 中填入生成的 `.tgz` 压缩包路径即可。

---

## ⚙️ 快捷键与配置项

进入 **DSH【设置】→【通用】** 或 **【快捷重启】**：

| 配置项 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **重启快捷键** (`hotkey`) | `Ctrl+Shift+R` | 点击“录制按键”后直接敲击键盘组合键自动保存，亦可使用内置预设 |
| **重启前弹窗二次确认** (`confirmBeforeRestart`) | `true` | 开启后按下快捷键先弹出确认模态框；关闭后按下快捷键将立即直接重启 |
| **测试重启应用** | - | 点击可立即模拟执行一次平滑重启过程，用于验证运行状态 |

---

## 🧪 自动化测试验证

本项目自带完备的单元测试，涵盖快捷键解析、规范化比对、按键匹配算法、进程路径识别与 Cordis 契约验证：

```bash
node test/hotkey.test.mjs
node test/restart.test.mjs
node test/plugin-wiring.test.mjs
```

## 📄 开源协议

本项目采用 [MIT](LICENSE) 协议开源。

plugins.description: Agent-native, local-first knowledge management plugin for DeepSeekHarness with Markdown, WebDAV sync, and extensible RAG.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-knowspace

**Agent-native, local-first knowledge infrastructure for DeepSeekHarness.**

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README_zh.md)

> **Status: Work in progress · Public placeholder · No public alpha release**  
> Last README update: October 12, 2026. Development continues in a private repository. This public repository currently serves as the project's official landing page; it does not provide an installable plugin or publicly auditable source code.

`dsh-knowspace` aims to make personal knowledge available to both people and authorized AI agents without making a cloud service, a vector database, or an always-on AI process the owner of that knowledge. It is designed as a [DeepSeekHarness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin, not a separate knowledge server.

The long-term goal is a shared foundation for notes, retrieval, rendering, and interaction that other agents, Skills, scripts, and domain-specific plugins can reuse.

## Why KnowSpace?

Most AI workflows treat knowledge as one-off chat context or an external retrieval service. KnowSpace takes a different approach:

- **Your files are the source of truth.** Markdown notes and images remain ordinary, portable local assets.
- **Agents work within permissions.** Access is scoped by workspace and user policy; knowledge is not silently exposed to every agent.
- **Offline comes first.** Reading, editing, and baseline search should work without network access.
- **Sync is optional.** A WebDAV endpoint can exchange supported knowledge assets between devices without hosting a separate KnowSpace service.
- **Interactive content is reusable infrastructure.** Math rendering, diagrams, temporary pages, and input collection belong in common capabilities rather than being reinvented by every Skill.

**Design principle:** Your knowledge, your control. AI participation should be explicit, scoped, and reviewable.

## Project status

The first five internal development rounds have been recorded as closed in the private project's progress history. **This is not equivalent to completing public release acceptance.** Some implementation results have been reported internally, while important security, synchronization, and end-to-end checks remain part of the acceptance plan.

| Area | Current description | Public availability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DeepSeekHarness Host/Client integration and sidebar | Implemented in private development records; compatibility is version-sensitive | Not released |
| Local workspaces, Markdown, JPG/PNG assets, basic search | Implemented/reported internally; subject to regression checks | Not released |
| Agent knowledge tools, edits, and change previews | Implemented/reported internally; end-to-end gateway checks are tracked separately | Not released |
| Markdown and mathematical notation | Existing private implementation and test history; maintained rather than rewritten | Not released |
| WebDAV bidirectional synchronization | Designed and worked on internally; cross-device/conflict/data-safety evidence must satisfy release gates | Not released |
| Interactive HTML, drawing input, submission bridge | Partially implemented or planned; security sandbox and real UI flows are not yet fully accepted | Not released |
| Editable knowledge diagrams and advanced local retrieval | Architecture decisions made; integration and acceptance are pending | Not released |

**No installation instructions are published yet.** A pinned, reproducible installation process and compatibility matrix will accompany the first usable alpha release. Please do not treat a development design or an example tool name as a supported public API.

## Product capabilities and direction

### 1. Knowledge: workspaces, files, and optional sync

Two intended workspace modes keep their responsibilities separate:

| Workspace | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| **Local** | Independent knowledge workspace stored on the current device; never synced automatically. |
| **Synced** | Complete local working copy with optional, bidirectional WebDAV synchronization when connectivity is available. |

Markdown is the primary portable knowledge format. The default **sync allowlist** is `.md`, `.jpg`, and `.png`; PDF, video, audio, 3D files, executable content, and native diagram sources are not automatically uploaded as originals. Rich media may remain local. A Markdown document explicitly derived from rich media is an independent knowledge asset, not a continuously attached copy of its source.

The design prioritizes change history, understandable diffs, collision protection, non-destructive conflict handling, and recovery over silent overwrites.

### 2. Retrieval: local-first search and evidence

KnowSpace starts with workspace-aware textual retrieval. Its planned search improvements borrow *ideas* from Greb-style candidate retrieval and ranking, but **do not use a cloud Greb API or make any third-party MCP service mandatory**.

The intended retrieval path is:

```text
Authorized workspaces
        |
Local text / file candidates
        |
Filtering + ranking / optional fusion
        |
Traceable source passages
        |
Agent answer or user-facing search result
```

Optional local accelerators such as ripgrep or SQLite FTS5 may be used when compatible. In-process scanning remains the fallback. Embeddings and reranking are optional later extensions, not prerequisites for a useful knowledge library.

### 3. Rendering: Markdown, math, and safe previews

The shared rendering layer is intended to support:

- Markdown notes, tables, code blocks, and image references.
- LaTeX-style mathematical expressions and math-friendly study material.
- Safe, bounded previews of knowledge content and tool results.
- Temporary interactive artifacts where the Host can enforce isolation, permissions, and resource limits.

Untrusted HTML/JavaScript must not gain access to the Host, filesystem, or agent permissions merely because it is displayed in a note or preview. Interactive execution is gated separately from Markdown rendering.

### 4. Interaction: agent-to-user workflows

Beyond static reading, KnowSpace is being designed to support explicit agent-created interaction flows: a temporary page or form is shown to the user, the user submits structured input or an image, and the authorized agent receives that result through a controlled bridge.

Examples include handwritten mathematical answers, study exercises, research review forms, and Skill-generated visual tools. These are examples of reusable infrastructure, **not a promise that a full exam platform or research product is included in the core plugin**.

### 5. Knowledge diagrams: editable diagrams rather than image generation

A planned diagram capability will represent flowcharts, mind maps, and system architecture diagrams as **editable vector/structured assets**, rather than requiring photorealistic image-generation models.

The selected approach is to selectively adapt suitable `.drawio` parsing, model, and layout concepts/code from [fourzkw/dsh-drawai](https://github.com/fourzkw/dsh-drawai), subject to pinned-source and license review. Host authorization, workspace handling, and agent tools remain owned by KnowSpace. The native editable `.drawio` source is local-only by default; an explicitly exported `.png` can be stored as a separate knowledge asset under the normal sync policy.

**This diagram integration has been designed, not shipped.**

## Intended architecture

```text
DeepSeekHarness
  |-- Sidebar / knowledge UI
  |-- Agent tools (scoped operations)
  |-- Skills and other plugins
  |
  `-- dsh-knowspace plugin
       |-- Knowledge Core: workspaces / assets / changes / access
       |-- Retrieval Core: local search / source evidence
       |-- Rendering Core: Markdown / math / safe previews
       |-- Interaction Core: temporary artifacts / user submissions
       |-- Diagram capability: editable structured assets (planned)
       |
       |-- Local filesystem and indexes
       `-- Optional WebDAV synchronization (allowlisted files)

No dedicated KnowSpace server or mandatory cloud vector database.
```

This diagram describes the **target architecture**, not

plugins.description: Self-contained outbound proxy for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: bundled mihomo core, Clash subscription import, its own latency ranking and automatic failover. No third-party proxy client, no system proxy.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-net-proxy

**Paste this into your AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, DeepSeek Harness — anything that can run commands) and it will install and configure this plugin for you:**

```text
Install the DSH plugin at https://github.com/FIZMIE/dsh-net-proxy into my DeepSeek Harness.
Read its README, wire it into ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json and cordis.patch.yml,
then use the tools in its tools/ directory to fetch the mihomo core and geodata.
Ask me for my Clash subscription link, import it, turn the proxy on, and
verify it works by fetching https://github.com.
```

*A self-contained outbound proxy for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app.*

[中文说明](README.zh.md)

> **You need a subscription.** This plugin is a *client*. It does not sell, provide or
> bypass anything by itself — bring a Clash-format subscription link from whatever
> provider you already use. Without one it has no nodes to connect through.

---

## What it does

Paste a Clash subscription link once. The plugin then:

1. **Starts its own proxy core** — a bundled mihomo binary, so nothing else has to be installed
2. **Measures every node itself** against `https://github.com`, concurrently
3. **Uses the fastest one**, and switches automatically when a node dies
4. **Routes the agent's traffic through it** — `web_fetch`, model calls, and child processes like `git` and `npm`

No Clash client running in the background. No system proxy. No hosts file. No admin rights.

---

## Why it exists

Asking an agent to work with GitHub from a censored network goes like this: the request
times out, the agent concludes the network is broken, and you end up explaining your proxy
setup by hand, every session.

The usual fixes do not fit an agent:

- **A system proxy** is invisible to it — `fetch` inside a Node process does not use one.
- **A GUI proxy client** may not be running, and the agent cannot start a GUI app from its sandbox.
- **The client's own `url-test` group** re-tests on a fixed interval (often daily) against
  `gstatic.com`, which is not the site you actually care about, and it does not re-test when
  a request fails.

So this plugin measures the thing that matters, when it matters, and switches when a request
fails.

---

## Install

### The one-prompt way

Copy the block at the top of this file into an agent that can run shell commands. It has
everything it needs: the repo URL, where the profile lives, which tools to run, and how to
verify the result.

### By hand

```powershell
# 1. Clone somewhere permanent (not into the profile's node_modules)
git clone https://github.com/FIZMIE/dsh-net-proxy.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\plugins\dsh-net-proxy"

# 2. Let the profile see it
#    Add to $DSH_HOME\profiles\<profile>\package.json:
#      "dependencies": { "dsh-net-proxy": "link:C:/Users/<you>/.dsh/plugins/dsh-net-proxy" }
#      "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ ..., "dsh-net-proxy" ] } }
#    then create the link so the loader resolves the name:
New-Item -ItemType Junction `
  -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-net-proxy" `
  -Target "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\plugins\dsh-net-proxy"

# 3. Register the bundle in $DSH_HOME\profiles\<profile>\cordis.patch.yml:
#      - id: dsh-net-proxy
#        disabled: false

# 4. Check the pieces are in place
node "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\plugins\dsh-net-proxy\tools\verify-setup.mjs"

# 5. Restart DeepSeek Harness (a new host plugin cannot be hot-mounted)
```

The core and geodata are **committed to this repository**, so step 5 is the last one —
there is nothing to download. If you want to refresh them later (or you stripped them out
to keep the clone small), see [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md).

---

## Use

Open **Settings → Network proxy**.

- **First time:** paste your subscription link, press **Update subscription**
- **Every other time:** press **Enable proxy**. That is the whole flow — it starts the core,
  ranks the nodes and takes over outbound traffic in about two seconds.

The node table shows every node with its measured latency; click one to pin it, or
**Fastest (automatic)** to go back to automatic selection. **Activity log** shows what the
plugin has been doing.

### It stays off until you ask

Opening the app does **nothing**: no core process, no subscription download, no dispatcher
(~4 ms). A previous session's "on" does not restore itself — the plugin starts closed and
waits for you to enable it. If you would rather not think about it, the agent-memory section
below tells the agent to enable it when a task needs it.

### Agent memory

On install the plugin appends a short section to `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md` teaching the agent
that the proxy exists and how to turn it on. Without it the agent has no way to know, and
would keep reporting GitHub as unreachable. It is written **once**, and only when no such
section is present — a file you have since edited is never rewritten. Set
`"writeMemory": false` in `$DSH_HOME/.dsh-net-proxy/config.json` to opt out.

---

## Verified behaviour

Measured against a real 23-node subscription:

| | |
|---|---|
| Nodes ranked | 23/23 reachable, fastest ≈ 90 ms, slowest ≈ 274 ms |
| Click to live | ≈ 2 s from pressing *Enable* |
| Cost of app start | ≈ 4 ms, and no process started |
| Exit IP, proxy on | `5.34.221.111` — Tokyo, JP (Akari Networks) |
| Exit IP, proxy off | `112.50.79.219` — Guangzhou, CN (China Mobile) |
| Failover | current node retired → walked to the next → `https://github.com` returned 200 |
| Loopback | stays direct (`127.0.0.1:19387` reached DSH itself, not the proxy) |

The core's own log is the proof that traffic went through it rather than somewhere else:

```
[TCP] 127.0.0.1:60196 --> github.com:443 match DomainKeyword(github) using 九云[...]
[TCP] 127.0.0.1:60206 --> 127.0.0.1:19387 match IPCIDR(127.0.0.0/8) using DIRECT
```

---

## Design notes

Worth reading before changing the code — most of these were learned the hard way.

**The subscription document is never reshaped.** mihomo's YAML parser rejects duplicate
mapping keys (stricter than the YAML spec), so prepending your own keys fails outright, and
lifting a block like `dns:` out of the document breaks its neighbours. The plugin rewrites
only a handful of listener/controller **scalars, in place**, and leaves every block exactly
where the provider put it — including provider quirks such as unquoted full-width colons in
node names.

**The subscription's own selector group is used, not a new one.** Creating a group would mean
editing the group list, which runs into the paragraph above. Real subscriptions ship a
selector covering all their nodes, so the plugin discovers it through the API and switches
within it.

**The proxy is swapped without a restart.** Routing goes through a single undici dispatcher
installed into Node's global-dispatcher slot — the same cross-package mechanism
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-http-proxy` uses. Because the dispatcher is read per request, a node switch
changes where the very next request goes.

**Geodata must be bundled, and must be the full set.** A subscription's rules reference
`GEOIP,CN` / `GEOSITE`, so the core needs the databases *before* it can parse the config.
Missing them, it tries to download from GitHub and **hangs with no error at all**. Pointing
`geox-url` at nothing makes it exit fatally. The "lite" databases omit the `gfw` category,
and a subscription whose DNS config references it fails with
`list gfw not found in geosite.dat`. The core also looks for these files in its *working
directory*, not beside the executable, so they are copied there on every start.

**The subscription download has a second path through the bundled core.** The host's own
`fetch` is subject to whatever proxy environment the process carries, and on a censored
network it may simply have no route out — which is the worst place to fail, because that
download is the plugin's only way in. So when `fetch` fails, the plugin starts its bundled
core on a throwaway config containing nothing but `MATCH,DIRECT` (no subscription, no nodes,
no geodata needed to boot), uses it as an HTTP proxy for the download, then tears it down. A
separate process with an ordinary network stack

plugins.description: 三省六部制多智能体审核流程，移植为 DeepSeek Harness 插件：12 状态状态机、门下省封驳、高风险确认、越权矩阵、委派防死锁、完整审计、军机处看板。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-edict ⚔️

**三省六部制多智能体审核流程，移植为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件。**

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-edict?color=cb3837&label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-edict)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-edict?color=3fbf6f)](LICENSE)
[![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4b8bf5)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

> 玩法来自 [**cft0808/edict**](https://github.com/cft0808/edict)（MIT，★16k+）：用 1300 年前的三省六部制重新设计多 Agent 协作。
> 本插件是它**审核流程逻辑的忠实移植**——状态机、封驳规则、高风险确认、越权矩阵、委派防死锁、审计留痕，逐条对齐。
>
> ```
> 你(皇上) → 太子(分拣) → 中书省(规划) → 门下省(审议·可封驳) → 尚书省(派发) → 六部(并行执行) → 回奏
> ```

---

## 为什么要有这个移植

| | 原版 edict | **dsh-edict** |
|---|---|---|
| 宿主 | OpenClaw（必装） | **DeepSeek Harness** |
| 语言/依赖 | Python 3.9+ / FastAPI / Postgres 可选 | **纯 Node，零依赖** |
| 安装 | `install.sh` / Docker / 注册 agent 到 `openclaw.json` | **`dsh plugin add dsh-edict`** |
| 数据 | kanban JSON / Postgres | `~/.dsh/edict/`（JSON，原子写） |
| 多 Agent 从哪来 | OpenClaw 的 11 个 agent 进程 | **DSH 子代理 / 你自己扮演衙门** |
| 审核规则 | 见下 | **逐条一致**（有测试证明） |

---

## 规则（与 edict 逐条对齐）

### 12 状态状态机

```
Pending → Taizi → Zhongshu → Menxia → Assigned → Next/Doing → Review → Done
终态：Done / Cancelled（无出边）
```

完整合法转换表：

| 状态 | 可转到 |
|---|---|
| `Pending` | Taizi, Cancelled |
| `Taizi` | Zhongshu, Cancelled |
| `Zhongshu` | Menxia, Cancelled, Blocked |
| **`Menxia`** | Assigned, **Zhongshu（封驳打回）**, Cancelled |
| `Assigned` | Doing, Next, Cancelled, Blocked |
| `Next` | Doing, Cancelled, Blocked |
| `Doing` | Review, Done, Blocked, Cancelled |
| `Review` | Done, **Menxia（复审）**, Doing, Cancelled, PendingConfirm |
| `PendingConfirm` | Done, Review, Cancelled |
| `Blocked` | Taizi, Zhongshu, Menxia, Assigned, Next, Doing, Review, Cancelled |

**非法转换一律拒绝**，并写 `state_rejected` 审计。

### 高风险操作要确认（拦在 PendingConfirm）

| 转换 | 确认方 |
|---|---|
| `Review → Done`（完结任务） | **menxia**（门下省） |
| `Doing → Cancelled`（执行中取消） | **shangshu**（尚书省） |
| `Menxia → Cancelled`（审核中取消） | **zhongshu**（中书省） |

不直接生效：先落 `PendingConfirm`，由确认方 `approve`（落到目标状态）或 `reject`（**退回 Review 复审**）。

### 硬校验

- **`done` 前置**：当前状态必须是 `Doing`/`Next`，且 **todos 全部完成**，否则拒绝（"todos 未完成（1/2），禁止直接收口"）
- **单一 in-progress**：同一任务同时最多 1 个 `in-progress` todo
- **委派防死锁**：深度 ≤ 3，**路径成环直接拒绝**
- **委派权限链**：太子→中书省；中书省→门下省/尚书省；尚书省→六部；六部→只能回报尚书省
- **标题校验**：长度 ≥6 且不能是闲聊词（`好`/`收到`/`测试`…）
- **越权矩阵**：六部不能改状态，门下省不能 create……（11 个角色的命令白名单）

### 审计

每条动作都落 `~/.dsh/edict/audit_log.json`（保留最近 5000 条），含 `ts / task / agent / action / from / to / reason`。拒绝也留痕。

---

## 安装

**从 npm 装**（推荐，一行）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-edict
```

**从 GitHub 装**（想跟最新提交，或 npm 不可用时）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Caoran1314/dsh-edict
```

**本地开发**（改代码即时生效，无需重装）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:D:\path\to\dsh-edict
```

装完重启 DSH。数据目录 `~/.dsh/edict/`。

> `--profile` 填你实际在用的那个：桌面客户端用 `desktop`，`dsh web` 用 `web`。

## 提供的工具

| 工具 | 对应衙门/命令 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `edict_create` | 皇上/太子 `create` | 下旨建任务 |
| `edict_move` | 三省 `state` | 状态流转（含合法性与高风险拦截） |
| `edict_flow` | 各省 `flow` | 部门间流转留痕 |
| `edict_progress` | 六部/各省 `progress` | 实时进展 + `✅/🔄` 清单同步 todos |
| `edict_todo` | 六部 `todo` | 子任务（单一 in-progress） |
| `edict_done` | 六部 `done` | 回报完成 → Review（前置硬校验） |
| `edict_block` | 六部 `block` | 标记阻塞 |
| `edict_confirm` | 门下/尚书 `confirm` | 批准 / 驳回高风险操作 |
| `edict_delegate` | 中书/尚书 `delegate` | 委派（深度+循环+权限链校验） |
| `edict_delegate_result` | 六部 `delegate-result` | 回写子任务结果 |
| `edict_memory` | 全部 `memory` | 衙门记忆（上限 200，pinned 优先） |
| `edict_task_memo` | 全部 `task-memo` | 任务级决策/警示备忘 |
| `edict_shared_memo` | 尚书 `shared-memo` | 全局共享备忘 |
| `edict_status` | 只读 | 军机处看板：各状态数量 / 任务详情 / 流转链 / 待确认项 |
| `edict_role` | — | 设置当前衙门身份（越权矩阵据此生效） |

命令（无 UI 界面时用）：`edict`（看板）、`edict-audit`（审计）、`edict-reset-role`。

### 身份如何确定

越权矩阵需要一个"当前是谁"。DSH 的子代理没有独立环境变量（不像 OpenClaw 的 `OPENCLAW_AGENT_ID`），所以推断链是：

```
工具参数 agent  →  EDICT_AGENT_ID 环境变量  →  ~/.dsh/edict/current_role  →  默认 taizi
```

**子代理开工前先调 `edict_role` 设定身份**，之后再调 `edict_*`，越权矩阵才按你的身份生效。

---

## 用法示例

```
你：用三省六部流程做「把首页加载时间降到 1 秒以内」

1. edict_create(title:"把首页加载时间降到 1 秒以内")        → Pending
2. edict_role(role:"taizi") + edict_move(state:"Taizi")      → 太子分拣
3. edict_role(role:"zhongshu") + edict_move(state:"Zhongshu")→ 中书省规划
4. edict_todo ×N（拆子任务）+ edict_move(state:"Menxia")     → 交门下省审议
5. edict_role(role:"menxia")
   - 不通过 → edict_move(state:"Zhongshu", now:"封驳：缺少回滚方案")
   - 通过   → edict_move(state:"Assigned")
6. edict_role(role:"shangshu") + edict_move(state:"Doing")
   + edict_delegate(to:"hubu", instruction:"…")              → 派发给六部
7. edict_role(role:"hubu") + edict_progress / edict_todo / edict_done
8. edict_role(role:"shangshu") + edict_move(state:"Done")
   → 落 PendingConfirm，edict_role(role:"menxia") + edict_confirm(action:"approve") → Done
```

---

## 与本移植的差异（诚实清单）

规则一致，适配层有三处必然差异，另有两处**实现层差异**（语言/内部一致性问题，非规则改动）：

| 项 | 原版 edict | 本移植 | 性质 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 身份来源 | `OPENCLAW_AGENT_ID` 等环境变量 | 同上 + 工具参数 + 角色文件 | 适配（DSH 无 per-subagent env） |
| 存储 | kanban JSON / Postgres 双写 | `~/.dsh/edict/` JSON 原子写 | 适配 |
| 多 Agent | 11 个 OpenClaw agent 进程 | DSH 子代理 / 人工扮演 | 适配 |
| todos 清单解析 | Python `item[:-1]`（按码位） | `Array.from` 后删末位（按码位） | **语言差异**：JS 里 `slice(0,-1)` 会切断 emoji 代理对，故必须按码位处理 |
| `progress` 替换 todos 后 | 不重算 `ready_to_close`（`cmd_todo` 才置位） | **重算**，保持标记与 todos 一致 | 实现增强（上游内部不一致） |

> 另：垃圾词比较**刻意保持上游行为**——上游 `if t in _JUNK_TITLES` 是集合精确匹配、不忽略大小写，

# dsh-balance-usage DeepSeek Harness 插件：在侧边栏**左下角**用**绿色**显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与**当前峰谷时段** （空闲 / 忙碌），点击展开账户余额、峰谷切换倒计时、忙碌时段时间表与近期用量统计； 并在输入框下方与每一轮的用量旁边，按**官方高峰 / 空闲价**估算**每个会话**与**每一轮**的花费。 只依赖 DSH 官方账号服务与本地会话日志，不接入任何第三方服务。
English overview A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that adds cost awareness to the Web UI. It shows the DeepSeek account balance and the current peak / off-peak phase in the sidebar, and estimates per-session and per-turn cost using the official peak and off-peak rates. The balance comes from DSH's own account service and the cost is estimated from local session logs — it talks to no third-party service. - **Sidebar footer (bottom-left)** — the account balance in green when healthy, plus a coloured dot and a label stating whether it is currently **off-peak** or **peak** (peak = twice the off-peak price). Clicking opens a panel with the balance, the current pricing window with a live countdown to the next switch, the peak-hours timetable, and recent usage (today / last 7 days / last N days, a 14-day chart, and a per-model table). - **Composer dock** — an inline `本会话消耗 ≈¥x` pill next to DSH's own session usage line. Clicking expands an anchored panel **upwards** (a `position: fixed` portal, so the row never grows). - **Per-turn actions row** — an inline `本轮花费 ≈¥x` trigger rendered in the same row as DSH's built-in `本轮用量` trigger, using flex `order` to sit to its right. Pricing follows the official rules: peak is **Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time**; weekends and Chinese public holidays are off-peak all day. Un-cached input, cache reads, cache writes and output are priced separately, using the token fields DSH records per request. Everything is local: the client talks to the host half over one read-only loopback route (`/dsh-balance-usage/summary` and `/dsh-balance-usage/session`). Credentials are never touched by the plugin — the balance comes from DSH's account service, or from a `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` only when the official account is not signed in. `npm test` runs `test/verify.mjs`, a dependency-free offline end-to-end verifier (176 assertions) that drives the real host route handler with fake services and renders the client half through a minimal React compatibility layer. The rest of this document is in Chinese.
--- ## 功能 ### 1. 左下角余额条目（绿色） - 侧边栏展开时：钱包图标 + `余额` + 金额胶囊 + 时段圆点 + 时段文字。 - 侧边栏收起（56px 轨道）时：紧凑显示 `¥12.34`，圆点颜色依旧表示峰谷。 - 金额按余额状态着色： - **充足 → 绿色**（`--dsw-alias-state-success-primary`） - 偏低 → 琥珀色（低于 `lowBalanceThreshold`，默认 10） - 为 0 → 红色 - 时段圆点：**绿色 = 空闲时段**，**琥珀色 = 忙碌时段**。 - 悬停提示会同时给出余额、当前时段与「距切换还有多久」。 ### 2. 点击展开的浮层面板 | 区块 | 内容 | |---|---| | 账户余额 | 总额（大字、按状态着色，**点击直接跳官方账号页**）、充值 / 赠送拆分、余额来源；「官方账号」与「充值」分别打开官方用量页 / 充值页 | | 当前计价时段 | 空闲 / 忙碌胶囊、当前北京时间、**距下一次切换的实时倒计时**与切换时刻 | | 忙碌时段（高峰计价） | 明确列出 **周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（北京时间）**，并说明高峰价 = 空闲价 × 2、周末与法定节假日全天按空闲计价 | | 近期用量 | 今日 / 近 7 天 / 近 N 天的 Token、估算费用、请求次数；近 14 天每日 Token 柱状图；按模型拆分表 | - **竖条悬停看详情**：鼠标移到每日柱状图上会弹出明细浮层 —— 日期、合计 Token、输入 / 输出、 缓存命中、请求次数、高峰 / 空闲拆分，以及当天的**花费**。 - Token 一律用 **K / M** 表示（不换算成 B），大小量级之间可以直接比较。 - 面板 **560px 宽**，高度贴合可用窗口（最多占满视口高度减去 32px），内容超出时面板内部滚动。 - 面板通过 `react-dom` 的 portal 渲染到 `document.body`，用 `position: fixed` 贴住左下角条目向上展开， 因此不受侧边栏 `overflow` 与过渡动画的裁剪影响。 - 点击面板外部或按 `Esc` 关闭；点「刷新」、**右键余额条目**、或窗口重新获得焦点都会立即刷新。 - **自动刷新间隔可调**：面板底部有下拉框（关闭 / 15 秒 / 1 分钟 / 2 分钟 / 5 分钟 / 15 分钟）， 改动立即生效并存进 `localStorage`（键名 `dsh-balance-usage.prefs`）。默认值来自 Host 的 `config.refreshSeconds`（出厂 60 秒）。 - **外观可切换**：面板底部的「外观」分三档 —— **默认**（跟随应用主题）/ **深色** / **浅色**， 选择也存进 `dsh-balance-usage.prefs`，两个浮层（左下角面板、底部与每轮的花费浮层）一起生效。 深色 / 浅色不是另画一套配色，而是在浮层根元素上**覆盖官方主题 token** （`--dsw-alias-bg-overlay`、`--dsw-alias-label-*`、`--dsw-alias-border-*` 等）， 浮层里所有既有规则整体跟随，不会出现「不深不浅」的半吊子配色。 - **不会让你白等一个刷新周期**：刚打开 Harness 时 Host 路由可能刚注册、当前会话也可能还没有用量， 这时每 3 秒重试一次直到拿到数据（拿到后交回常规刷新间隔）；页面重新可见或窗口重新获得焦点时 也会立刻刷新。Host 侧也**不再缓存失败结果**，避免客户端在 TTL 内一直拿不到数据。 ### 3. 对话下方：本会话花费 注册进 `conversation.composer.dock`（输入框下方那一栏）： ``` 🎛 本会话消耗 ≈ ¥5.67 ← 胶囊是 inline-flex，和官方那行用量统计并排同一行 ``` 点一下**向上**弹出明细浮层： ``` ┌───────────────────────────────┐ │ 🎛 本会话金额 ≈ ¥5.67 │ │ ───────────────────────────── │ │ 高峰花费 ≈ ¥1.20 │ │ 空闲花费 ≈ ¥4.47 │ │ 请求次数 128 次 │ │ 缓存命中率 99.4% │ │ 模型 deepseek-flash │ │ │ │ 本地按官方价表估算，非官方账单。│ └───────────────────────────────┘ ``` 关键是**展开不会改变那一栏的高度**（早期版本就是在这一点上做错了）： - 胶囊外层 `display:inline-flex`，与官方那行用量统计**并排**，不另起一行； - 展开的浮层是 **portal 到 `document.body` 的 `position: fixed` 元素**，用官方基元 `primitives.useAnchoredPosition({ side: "top", gap: 6, margin: 8 })` 锚在胶囊上沿并**向上**展开 —— 浮层完全脱离文档流，展开 / 收起时那一栏高度一个像素都不变； - 关闭走官方基元 `primitives.useDismissOnOutsidePointer`，另加 `Esc`； - 两个官方基元缺失时都有降级实现（自己按 `bottom` 定位 + 自己监听外部点击），功能不受影响； - 官方界面已经显示 Token 用量，所以这里**只谈钱**：胶囊显示金额，浮层显示花费拆分与请求数， 不再重复 `未缓存输入 / 缓存读取 / 输出` 那些数字； - 没有可统计用量时**整条不渲染**（不留占位、不留空行）。 数据来自 Host 的 `/dsh-balance-usage/session?sessionId=…`（按会话统计整个对话，不按时间窗口截断， 带 15 秒缓存），随自动刷新间隔一起更新。 ### 4. 每一轮：本轮花费 挂在 `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` —— 也就是**官方「本轮用量」所在的那一行**。 DSH 内部把该槽位的内容当作 `extraActions` 传给 `MessageIconActions`，而官方的 「本轮用量」正是同一个组件的 `usageAction`： ```jsx } // 官方「本轮用量 11.14M tok」 /> ``` `extraActions` 在 `usageAction` **之前**渲染，而 `.actions` 是 flex 容器， 所以本插件用 `order: 1` 把自己排到所有默认 `order: 0` 的兄弟之后，落到行尾： ``` … ⧉ ⑂ | 本轮用量 11.14M tok 12:34 | 🎛 本轮花费 ≈¥0.46 ↑ 本插件（order:1 排到最后） ``` - 触发器尺寸对齐官方 `TurnUsagePanel` 的触发器：`inline-flex`、高 `calc(28px + var(--dsh-content-font-delta,0px))`、`border-radius:var(--dsw-radius-sm)`， hover / 展开时用 `--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover` —— 和官方那个触发器是同一套控件； - 图标用官方的 **`IconGaugeOutlineRegular`**（仪表盘 = 计量 / 消耗）。 官方「本轮用量」用的是 `IconDatabaseOutlineRegular`，所以花费这边刻意不复用它； - 点击用**和官方完全相同的交互**向上弹出明细浮层（portal 到 body + `position: fixed` + `useAnchoredPosition({ side: "top" })`）：标题「本轮金额」+ 高峰花费 / 空闲花费 / 请求次数 / 模型； - 该槽位只提供 `messageId`，所以 Host 会把每一轮包含哪些 assistant 消息 id 一起返回， 客户端按 `messageId → 轮次 → 花费` 反查； - **没有该轮数据时返回 `null`**（该 slot 的契约明确允许「无内容的条目返回 null」）， 不会留空位、不会多出空白。 ### 5. 空闲 / 忙碌时段的官方口径 依据 DeepSeek 官方定价文档： > Off-peak rates are half of the peak rates. **Peak hours are 01:00 - 04:00 and 06:00 - 10:00 UTC, > Monday through Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays.** All other hours are off-peak, > including weekends and Chinese public holidays in full. > > —— 换算为北京时间（UTC+8）即： | | 时间 | |---|---| | **忙碌（高峰计价）** | 周一至周五 **09:00–12:00**、**14:00–18:00** | | **空闲（低谷计价）** | 工作日其余时间、**周六周日全天**、**中国法定节假日全天** | 内置了 `2026` 年法定节假日表（依据[国务院办公厅 2025-11-04 通知](https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/content/202511/content_7047090.htm)）， 可用 `holidays` 配置项整体覆盖。 峰谷归属按**请求发起时刻**（`step/start` 事件时间）判定，取不到时回退到消息完成时刻。 官方未公开跨时段请求按发起还是按完成计费，这是合理近似；实测请求耗时在秒级，边界影响极小。 ### 6. 价格表（空闲时段价，元 / 百万 tokens） | 模型 | 输入（缓存未命中） | 输入（缓存命中） | 输出 | |---|---|---|---| | `deepseek-flash` | 1 | 0.02 | 4 | | `deepseek-v4-pro` | 4.5 | 0.15 | 13.5 | | `deepseek-chat`（旧） | 2 | 0.5 | 3 | | `deepseek-reasoner`（旧） | 4 | 1 | 16 | 高峰时段按 ×2 计。模型名做了归一化：含 `pro` → v4-pro，含 `flash` → flash， 因此 `deepseek-flash` 与旧名 `deepseek-v4-flash` 走同一套价。 > **计费口径**：DSH 的 `TokenUsage.inputTokens` 是**未缓存输入**，不含缓存命中的部分 —— > 实测 `inputTokens + cacheReadTokens + cacheWriteTokens + outputTokens === totalTokens`， > 正好和官方价表的「INPUT (CACHE MISS)」/「INPUT (CACHE HIT)」两栏一一对应。 > 所以未缓存输入按 input 价、缓存读取按 cacheRead 价分别计价（早期版本曾把缓存读取从输入里 > 再减一次，导致未缓存输入被算成 0、费用偏低，已修正）。 --- ## 安装 本插件是一个标准的 DSH bundle 包（`package.json` 里带 `dsh.bundle.patch` 与 `dsh.client`）， 安装后由 profile 的 bundle 栈自动挂载，无需手改 `cordis.patch.yml`。 ### 已验证的安装方式（本地 link） ```powershell cd $env:DSH_PROFILE_DIR # 通常是 C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\desktop pnpm add "link:C:\Users\<你>\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\dsh-balance-usage" ``` 然后把 `dsh-balance-usage` 加进该 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组： ```json { "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles":

plugins.description: A shared Chromium browser workspace for DeepSeekHarness, designed for multi-agent automation, human takeover, and collaborative debugging.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-agent-team-browser **English** | [中文](README_zh.md) > **Status: architecture / pre-release.** This repository is being designed and implemented. The banner is conceptual artwork, not a screenshot of a released plugin. Features described as *planned* below are **not claims of working functionality**. Installation instructions, a tested compatibility range, and a release tag will be published **after** implementation and acceptance testing. Do not install a similarly named community package assuming it is this project. ## Summary **dsh-agent-team-browser** is a planned native **shared browser workspace for DeepSeekHarness (DSH)**. It is designed to integrate with DSH's official right sidebar and support **individual agents, Agent Teams, and human operators**—without requiring an external browser window to take foreground focus. One persistent browser workspace can contain multiple tabs. Authorized agents can work in different tabs concurrently, share an intentionally selected login context, and hand the **same tab** to another agent or a human through explicit control leases. The sidebar works like a monitor: switching the viewed tab does not switch, pause, or recreate the agents' background browser tasks. **Design principle:** **The team lead decides *who should do what*; the plugin enforces *who may do what, when, and on which browser resource*.** ## Project introduction > One browser workspace. Multiple agents. Human control when it matters. This project continues the `dsh-agent-team-*` naming family started by [bloodarea/dsh-agent-team-presets](https://github.com/bloodarea/dsh-agent-team-presets). The name emphasizes Agent Team collaboration, **not** an Agent Team-only dependency: it must also work for a single agent and for a person using the sidebar directly. The design deliberately separates three things that are often coupled together: | Layer | Responsibility | Lifetime | | --- | --- | --- | | **DSH Agent Session** | Who invokes a tool, including lead and teammates | Owned by DSH | | **Browser Workspace** | Browser contexts, tabs, permissions, retained state | Owned by this plugin | | **Sidebar Viewer** | Which tab a user is watching or controlling | Owned by the DSH UI | Closing the sidebar **must not** close a browser tab. Opening a teammate's distinct DSH Session **must not** create another browser just because its Session ID changed. When a team finishes, workspace retention and access revocation follow the workspace's explicit policy rather than the lifespan of the team chat. ## Why this plugin? Conventional browser MCPs, wrappers, and desktop automators often optimize for one agent controlling one visible browser. This project addresses six gaps: 1. **Host focus disruption.** Browser automation should not hijack the operating system's foreground mouse, keyboard, or active window. 2. **No coherent multi-agent ownership.** Multiple agents need one authorized workspace, not accidental duplication or concurrent navigation of the same tab. 3. **Sidebar-size-dependent viewport.** A narrow sidebar must not silently turn a `1920 × 1080` desktop test into a mobile layout. 4. **Weak human-in-the-loop control.** A person must be able to watch, take over one tab, resolve a difficult interaction, then return control to an agent. 5. **Insufficient developer visibility.** Network requests, responses, console messages, and cookies need inspectable, permission-aware tooling. 6. **Wrong lifecycle boundary.** Browser tabs should not disappear because a teammate's DSH Session was disposed or a sidebar pane was hidden. **Design principle:** the official DSH sidebar owns presentation; this plugin owns browser resources, identity-aware access, and concurrency safety. Browser execution remains independent from the presentation surface. ## Planned capabilities The following describes the **target specification**, not a completed feature list. | Capability | Intended behavior | | --- | --- | | **Native sidebar workspace** | Register a new Browser Workspace tab in the official DSH right sidebar, without replacing the built-in browser. | | **Silent browser runtime** | Headless Chromium + Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP); automation does not manipulate the host OS pointer or foreground window. | | **Multi-agent access** | Different DSH Sessions can bind to one authorized Browser Workspace by trusted Team/member identity. | | **Shared login state** | Tabs inside the same authorized `BrowserContext` share applicable cookies and same-origin storage. | | **Tab-level collaboration** | Separate tabs execute concurrently; one tab's multi-step writes require an exclusive lease. | | **Human takeover** | Observe the same page as an agent, request control, and return it without spawning a second page. | | **Independent viewport** | Per-tab CSS viewport, DPR, touch/mobile emulation; sidebar width only changes rendering scale. | | **Developer tools** | Inspect Fetch/XHR, response status/body (opt-in), Console, runtime errors, and governed cookie access. | | **Persistent workspaces** | Hide panes and switch agent chats without losing tabs; restore recoverable state after restart. | | **Solo mode** | Run without an Agent Team or `dsh-agent-team-presets` installed. | ### The sidebar is a viewer, not the browser process Think of the sidebar as a television and Chromium tabs as independent channels. Selecting another channel changes only the **viewed tab**. All other tabs continue running in the background; their pages, viewport sizes, and active agents remain unchanged. A human can take control of the channel being watched when permitted. ### Shared state does not mean shared page state Multiple tabs in one `BrowserContext` normally share cookies and, for the same origin, `localStorage` / IndexedDB. Each tab has its **own** DOM, URL, scroll state, and usually `sessionStorage`. Sites may impose additional authentication constraints; shared cookies do **not** guarantee universal single sign-on. Separate workspaces/teams are isolated by default unless sharing is explicitly authorized. ### Viewport is independent of sidebar dimensions For example, set the real page to `1920 × 1080` and display it inside a `420px` sidebar. The browser still reports approximately `window.innerWidth === 1920` CSS pixels (subject to page/environment specifics). The sidebar only fits or pans the rendered image. A human click is mapped back into browser coordinates before CDP receives it. Planned presets include `390 × 844`, `768 × 1024`, `1280 × 720`, and `1920 × 1080`; custom viewport sizes and DPR are separate controls. A resize of the DSH sidebar must **never** implicitly invoke a CDP viewport change. ## Use this package ### Availability and installation **There is no verified public install command or released version yet.** The proposed repository identity is `bloodarea/dsh-agent-team-browser`; availability of GitHub releases, npm packages, and plugin compatibility will be confirmed when a tested build exists. When the first release is published, this section will document: 1. Supported DSH release/commit or compatibility range and required Chromium runtime. 2. The exact **pinned release** installation command and which DSH profile to select. 3. Required Host/Client plugin configuration, startup procedure, and uninstall/migration steps. 4. How to verify the loaded plugin identity, version, sidebar entry, and browser runtime health. **Do not copy installation commands from `dsh-agent-team-presets`**: it is a distinct plugin with a separate release cycle. ### Intended workflow: a single agent 1. Open the planned **Browser Workspace** entry in the official right sidebar. 2. Create or select a workspace and open a browser tab. 3. Choose a viewport preset or enter a custom viewport. Resize the sidebar to observe that the page viewport stays unchanged. 4. Let the agent browse and test while you continue using the desktop nor
